node_notes.i2c_peripheral: The driver initializes the I2C1 master and configures its filters through STM32 HAL APIs. I2C1 is selected in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c.
node_notes.boot: Cube's main entry invokes app_start once before entering its otherwise empty loop. The call is evidenced in Core/Src/main.c and transfers control to firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.app: app_start initializes the shared I2C1 platform interface and logs either its failure or readiness. Its initialization and logging calls are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.i2c_driver: This STM32 implementation configures I2C1 and provides serialized transfer, register access, and scan operations. HAL_I2C_Init and the transfer APIs are implemented in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c.
node_notes.logger: The application uses LOGI and LOGE to report I2C startup status. firmware/utils/logger/logger.h implements these macros using printf.
node_notes.i2c_wires: This is the configured shared I2C wiring, with PB8 as SCL and PB9 as SDA. The pin macros are in firmware/configs/app_config.h, and the driver configures them for I2C alternate-function open-drain operation.
node_notes.output: This represents the formatted output reached by the logger macros; no UART routing or UART pin binding is established by the supplied firmware. The printf backing is declared in firmware/utils/logger/logger.h.

node_notes.error_log: On initialization failure, the application emits an error containing the status and returns without reporting the bus ready. The LOGE call and return are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.success_log: On successful initialization, the application logs that shared I2C1 is ready on PB8/PB9. The LOGI call is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.begin: This is the entry to the one-shot application startup routine, not a periodic task. The routine is defined as app_start in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.ready: This branch checks whether platform_i2c1_init returned PLATFORM_I2C1_STATUS_OK. The condition is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.init: The application requests platform I2C1 initialization and captures its status before deciding whether startup can proceed. The call is in firmware/app/app.c and the implementation is in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c.
node_notes.finish: Both paths leave app_start after their respective log action; the Cube caller then continues into its main loop. The function ending is in firmware/app/app.c.
